videos.title: It's time to panic about AI safety | The Vergecast
videos.description:
It's a big week for new ideas about computers, so David and Nilay spend some time on Samsung's vision for foldables and Mark Zuckerberg's vision for AI agents that do absolutely everything. Then they talk about the fallout from last week's OpenAI Hugging Face hack, and whether all this talk about AI safety will actually amount to anything. Finally, it's time for Brendan Carr is a Dummy, the vertical video takeover, and the smashing success of the Ferrari Luce.

videos.title: Meta's Oversight Board is coming for ChatGPT and Claude | The Vergecast
videos.description:
A new study from the Oversight Board found that leading AI systems are less likely to criticize authoritarian governments than democratic ones. It's a wild finding — but wait? Why is the Oversight Board studying systems from OpenAI and Anthropic in the first place? Suzanne Nossel, who sits on the board, joined us to discuss the findings and why the Oversight Board's future might involve looking at more than just Meta.

videos.title: New DJI Osmo Pocket 4P
videos.description: The new DJI Osmo Pocket 4P improves on the gimbal camera space but can it beat the competition? The Verge's Dominic Preston tested out the newest camera from DJI and compared its specs with the Osmo Pocket 4 and Insta360's Luna Ultra. It might be tough to pick a winner between the Osmo Pocket 4P (£529) and the Luna Ultra (£649) if you're in the market for either. If you're American, don't worry about deciding since neither the DJI Osmo Pocket 4 or 4P are available.

videos.title: The Z Fold 8 is the new foldable to beat | The Vergecast
videos.description:
The wide foldable is here, and it's glorious. The Verge's Dominic Preston has been reviewing Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8, and joins the show to explain what this shorter, wider device gets right, what it's still missing, and why this looks like the right kind of foldable for most people. (Once the price comes down, anyway.) With a similar foldable iPhone likely coming soon, it's shaping up to be a fun year of foldables.
